recorded: by rig/scenarios/claude-prompts.sh: the real claude binary in a rig hc terminal, private HOME, a scripted fake Anthropic API on the rig loopback, no network, no credentials; all content fake

files.permission: Bash permission dialog (default mode). Options: Yes / Yes, and don’t ask again for: cargo test * / Yes, and switch to auto mode / No. Footer: Esc to cancel · Tab to amend
files.ask-single: AskUserQuestion, one question, single select. 3 options + "Type something." (Other) + "Chat about this" below a rule
files.ask-other: ask-single with the cursor on the Other row ("4. Type something."): typing there is the Other input
files.ask-multi: AskUserQuestion multiSelect: rows "[ ]", an unnumbered "Submit" row after the Other row, tab bar with Submit tab
files.ask-multi-after-space: after one space on row 1: "[✔] Lint"; the tab icon changed from ☐ to ☒
files.ask-multi-after-down-enter: after down then enter on row 2: both rows toggled; Enter toggles too
files.ask-multi-on-submit: cursor on the unnumbered Submit row
files.ask-multi-review: Enter on Submit opens a review step: "Submit answers" / "Cancel"; a second Enter answers
files.plan: ExitPlanMode in plan mode: plan text, then "Yes, and use auto mode" / "Yes, manually approve edits" / "Tell Claude what to change"
files.stop-idle: CV8: idle claude, nothing in flight; footer "? for shortcuts"
files.stop-idle-after-esc: stop-idle after one Esc: unchanged (Esc does nothing when idle with an empty composer)
files.stop-idle-after-double-esc: then Esc Esc in one hc keys call with no history: unchanged
files.stop-working-stream: working while a reply streams ("H0-SLOW"): spinner line, footer "⏸ manual mode on · esc to interrupt · ← for agents"; hc get says status.state "working"
files.stop-stream-after-esc: one Esc while streaming: "⎿  Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?", footer back to "? for shortcuts"
files.stop-after-stop-double-esc: two Escs 300 ms apart, 2 s after an interrupt (idle with a history): the Rewind menu opens (Claude Code’s double-Esc)
files.stop-working-tool: working while a Bash call runs ("H0-TOOL", allowed): footer "esc to interrupt"; hc get "working"
files.stop-tool-after-esc: one Esc while the tool runs: the call gets an error result, "Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?"
files.stop-permission-after-esc: one Esc on a permission prompt: the prompt is cancelled (call rejected, turn interrupted). Why Stop refuses while a prompt is open
files.stop-second-esc-300ms: one second Esc 300 ms after the Esc that interrupted the agent: no Rewind (nor at 1 s, 2 s, 3.5 s: manifest stop.secondEsc)
files.stop-second-esc-3500ms: the same, 3.5 s after: no Rewind
files.stop-working-draft: working, with a desk draft "draft" in the composer: herdr-core "working", but the footer drops "esc to interrupt" (just "⏸ manual mode on")
files.stop-draft-after-esc: one Esc with that draft: the agent is interrupted and the draft stays in the composer

keys.multiSelectToggle: space or enter toggles the row under the cursor; down moves; Submit is the row after Other; Enter on it opens a review step with 1. Submit answers / 2. Cancel
keys.other: hc send is refused while the terminal is blocked on a dialog (kind "blocked"); hc send --force on the Other row pastes the text and answers
keys.cursor: the cursor ❯ must be searched only inside the block below the last full-width rule (the echoed user message also starts with ❯ at column 0); its column differs per dialog: 0 (ask), 1 (permission), 3 (plan)
keys.multiSelectPlusOther: NOT RECORDED: what typing on the "[ ] Type something" row of a multiSelect question does (checks the row? Enter toggles or submits?). CV7 must refuse {other} on a multiSelect question until this is recorded

stop.workingSignal: herdr-core status.state "working" (hc get) and the footer segment "esc to interrupt" on the last screen line; idle shows "? for shortcuts" there; blocked on a prompt: status.state "blocked", kind "permission"

transcript.whileStreaming: a user turn with one text block "[Request interrupted by user]"
transcript.whileTool: the call gets tool_result is_error true (toolUseResult "User rejected tool use"), then a user turn "[Request interrupted by user for tool use]"
transcript.onPermissionPrompt: the same as whileTool: Esc cancels the dialog and the call

stop.doubleEsc: two Escs 300 ms apart on an idle agent with a history open the Rewind menu (stop-after-stop-double-esc); one second Esc 300 ms, 1 s, 2 s or 3.5 s after the interrupting one does not. Stop’s 3 s cooldown is a margin against pairing, not a measured window
stop.deskDraft: a desk draft hides "esc to interrupt" from the footer while herdr still says working; one Esc interrupts and keeps the draft. Stop refuses (desk_draft)
